rows.label: Personal income tax (skatt på alminnelig inntekt and trinnskatt) [national and municipal]
rows.value: 22% on general income (18.5% in Troms and Finnmark); trinnskatt from 1.7% on personal income above NOK 226,100 (steps in the trinnskatt section). Paid by resident individuals. Skatteloven; Stortingets skattevedtak 2026.

source.title: Skatteetaten: Satser – Alminnelig inntekt (year 2026 selected)

rows.label: Municipal income tax (kommuneskatt) and county income tax (fylkesskatt) within the 22% on general income [national and municipal]
rows.value: Municipal rate at most 11.35% and county rate at most 2.40% of general income, with the state fellesskatt of 8.25% (4.75% in Finnmark and northern Troms) making up the 22%. Paid by resident individuals. Stortingets skattevedtak 2026 §§ 3-2 and 3-8.

source.title: Lovdata: Stortingsvedtak om skatt av inntekt og formue mv. for inntektsåret 2026 (Stortingets skattevedtak), FOR-2025-12-18-2747, last amended FOR-2026-06-19-1243

rows.label: Capital gains and dividends on shares (aksjeinntekt) [national]
rows.value: 37.84% effective (gain or dividend × 1.72 at 22%); other capital income 22%. Paid by individual shareholders. Skatteloven § 10-11; Stortingets skattevedtak 2026.

source.title: Skatteetaten: Satser – Faktor for oppjustering av gevinst/tap eller utbytte på aksjer (year 2026 selected)

rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends (kildeskatt på utbytte) [national]
rows.value: 25% on dividends to foreign shareholders, often 15% or lower under tax treaties; EEA companies may be exempt. Paid by foreign shareholders (withheld by the company). Skatteloven § 10-13.

source.title: Skatteetaten (Skattedirektoratet): Prinsipputtalelse – Kildeskatt på utbytte fra norske selskap til utenlandske aksjonærer

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (kildeskatt på lønn, PAYE) [national]
rows.value: 25% flat on pay below NOK 725,050 (17.4% with an exemption from national insurance); otherwise the ordinary rules. Paid by foreign workers (withheld by the employer). Skatteloven kapittel 19.

source.title: Skatteetaten: Kildeskatt på lønn for utenlandske arbeidstakere

rows.label: Social security contributions (trygdeavgift and arbeidsgiveravgift) [national]
rows.value: Employees 7.6% (pension 5.1%, business income 10.8%); employers 14.1% in zone I down to 0% in zone V. Paid by employees, the self-employed and employers. Folketrygdloven; Stortingets vedtak om avgifter til folketrygden 2026.

source.title: Lovdata: Stortingsvedtak om fastsetting av avgifter mv. til folketrygden for 2026 (FOR-2025-12-18-2748), §§ 1-5

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (trygdeavgift on business income) [national]
rows.value: 10.8% of business income (7.6% for fishing, hunting and childminding). Paid by sole proprietors. Folketrygdloven § 23-3.

source.title: Skatteetaten: Satser – Trygdeavgift (year 2026 selected)

rows.label: Contractor or employee: own account and risk (selvstendig næringsdrivende) [national]
rows.value: Overall assessment of the agreement; self-employed pay 10.8% trygdeavgift and no employer contributions are due. Paid by contractors and their clients. Folketrygdloven § 1-10; Skattedirektoratet's statement on the employee/self-employed line.

source.title: Skatteetaten (Skattedirektoratet): Prinsipputtalelse – Grensedragningen mellom arbeidstakere og selvstendig næringsdrivende

rows.label: Occupational pension (obligatorisk tjenestepensjon, OTP) [national]
rows.value: At least 2% of pay up to 12 G. Paid by employers. OTP-loven § 4.

source.title: Lovdata: Lov om obligatorisk tjenestepensjon (OTP-loven), LOV-2005-12-21-124

rows.label: Corporate income tax (selskapsskatt) [national]
rows.value: 22% on general income (25% for companies paying financial activity tax); 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750 million. Paid by companies. Skatteloven; suppleringsskatteloven.

source.title: Skatteetaten: Satser – Alminnelig inntekt (year 2026 selected)

rows.label: Value added tax (merverdiavgift) [national]
rows.value: 25% standard; 15% food; 12% passenger transport, cinema and room hire. Paid by consumers (collected by registered businesses). Merverdiavgiftsloven.

source.title: Skatteetaten: Satser – Merverdiavgift (year 2026 selected)

rows.label: Excise duties (særavgifter) on tobacco, alcohol and sugar [national]
rows.value: Cigarettes NOK 3.31 each; spirits NOK 9.23 per % vol. per litre; sugar NOK 9.67 per kg. Paid by consumers (paid by producers and importers). Stortingets vedtak om særavgifter 2026.

source.title: Skatteetaten: Satser – Tobakk (year 2026 selected)

rows.label: Electricity tax (forbruksavgift på elektrisk kraft) [national]
rows.value: 7.13 øre per kWh (reduced rate 0.60 øre). Paid by electricity consumers. Stortingets vedtak om avgift på elektrisk kraft 2026.

source.title: Skatteetaten: Satser – Elektrisk kraft (year 2026 selected)

rows.label: Property tax (eiendomsskatt) [municipal]
rows.value: 1 to 7 per mille of the assessed value, at most 4 per mille for homes and holiday homes; optional for each municipality. Paid by property owners. Eigedomsskattelova §§ 11 and 12.

source.title: Lovdata: Lov om eigedomsskatt til kommunane (eigedomsskattelova), LOV-1975-06-06-29

rows.label: Property transfer: document duty (dokumentavgift) [national]
rows.value: 2.5% of the market value on registering a transfer of real property. Paid by the buyer. Dokumentavgiftsloven; Stortingets vedtak om dokumentavgift.

source.title: Kartverket (Norwegian Mapping Authority, land registry): Ofte stilte spørsmål – dokumentavgift

rows.label: Wealth tax (formuesskatt) [national and municipal]
rows.value: 0.35% municipal and 0.65% state on net wealth above NOK 1,900,000; 0.75% state above NOK 21,500,000. Paid by resident individuals. Skatteloven; Stortingets skattevedtak 2026.

source.title: Skatteetaten: Satser – Formuesskatt og verdsettingsrabatter (year 2026 selected)

rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (arveavgift): none [national]
rows.value: None: abolished for deaths and gifts from 1 January 2014. Paid by no one. Arveavgiftsloven, repealed from 2014.

source.title: Skatteetaten: Arveavgift er fjernet

rows.label: Vehicle tax: traffic insurance levy (trafikkforsikringsavgift) [national]
rows.value: NOK 6.52 per 24 hours of liability insurance for cars under 7,500 kg, NOK 9.16 for electric cars, NOK 5.51 for motorcycles (policies from 1 March 2026). Paid by vehicle owners (collected by insurers). Stortingets vedtak om trafikkforsikringsavgift.

rows.label: CO2 tax on mineral products (CO2-avgift) [national]
rows.value: NOK 3.80 per litre of petrol; NOK 4.42 per litre of diesel; NOK 3.26 per Sm³ of natural gas. Paid by fuel consumers (paid by suppliers). Stortingets vedtak om CO2-avgift på mineralske produkter 2026.

source.title: Skatteetaten: Satser – Særavgift: mineralske produkter (year 2026 selected)

rows.value: 3% of the price of an overnight stay excluding VAT, in municipalities with an approved plan; the law applies from a date set by the King. Paid by guests (collected by accommodation providers). Lov om besøksbidrag (lovvedtak 110 (2024–2025)) § 2-3.

source.title: Stortinget: Lovvedtak 110 (2024–2025), lov om besøksbidrag

rows.label: Air passenger tax (flypassasjeravgift) [national]
rows.value: NOK 61 per passenger to Europe, NOK 350 to other destinations. Paid by airlines (passed on to passengers). Stortingets vedtak om flypassasjeravgift 2026.

rows.label: Pension income: social security contribution at the low rate (trygdeavgift av pensjon) [national]
rows.value: Pensions bear the social security contribution (trygdeavgift) at 5.1%, against 7.6% on wages, in addition to income tax; a pension tax deduction of up to NOK 39,100 applies (Stortingets skattevedtak 2026 § 6-5). Paid by pensioners. Stortingsvedtak om fastsetting av avgifter mv. til folketrygden for 2026, §§ 6 and 7; skatteloven § 16-1.

rows.section: List of taxes and charges in Norway
rows.note: Checklist item B2
rows.source_title: Skatteetaten: A-meldingen, veiledning – Finansskatt på lønn
rows.label: Payroll tax in the financial sector: financial tax on wages (finansskatt på lønn) [national]
rows.value: 5% of the wage base used for the employer's social security contribution, for employers whose staff carry out financial activities (SN2007 section K); employers whose financial-activity wages are under 30% of total wage costs are exempt. Paid by employers in the financial sector. Folketrygdloven § 23-2 a; Skatteetaten, Finansskatt på lønn.

rows.section: List of taxes and charges in Norway
rows.note: Checklist item C2
rows.source_title: Lovdata: Lov om skatt av formue og inntekt (skatteloven), § 18-2 Naturressursskatt til kommunen og fylkeskommunen (as amended by lov 20 des 2024 nr. 86, from the 2025 income year)
rows.label: Local business tax on power plants: natural resource tax (naturressursskatt) [municipal]
rows.value: 1.13 øre per kWh to the municipality and 0.21 øre per kWh to the county, on one seventh of the plant's output over the income year and the six previous years; plants under 10,000 kVA are exempt; credited against the state common tax. Paid by owners of power plants. Skatteloven § 18-2.

rows.section: List of taxes and charges in Norway
rows.note: Checklist item C3
rows.source_title: Lovdata: Lov om merverdiavgift (merverdiavgiftsloven), § 2-1 Registreringsplikt
rows.label: Simplified regime for small businesses: no VAT registration up to NOK 50,000 turnover (registreringsplikt i Merverdiavgiftsregisteret) [national]
rows.value: Businesses register for VAT only once taxable turnover exceeds NOK 50,000 in twelve months (NOK 140,000 for charitable and non-profit institutions). Paid by small businesses. Merverdiavgiftsloven § 2-1.

rows.section: List of taxes and charges in Norway
rows.note: Checklist item C4
rows.source_title: Lovdata: Stortingsvedtak om skatt av inntekt og formue mv. for inntektsåret 2026 (Stortingets skattevedtak), FOR-2025-12-18-2747, chapter 3 and §§ 3-3, 3-5 and 6-5
rows.label: Tax on distributed profits paid abroad: dividend withholding tax for foreign shareholders (kildeskatt på utbytte) [national]
rows.value: 25% of share dividends distributed to shareholders resident abroad, or the lower treaty rate. Paid by foreign shareholders (withheld by the distributing company). Stortingets skattevedtak for inntektsåret 2026, § 3-5 third paragraph.

rows.section: List of taxes and charges in Norway
rows.note: Checklist item D4
rows.source_title: Lovdata: Stortingsvedtak om skatt av inntekt og formue mv. for inntektsåret 2026 (Stortingets skattevedtak), FOR-2025-12-18-2747, chapter 3 and §§ 3-3, 3-5 and 6-5
rows.label: Financial activities tax: 25% income tax rate for financial companies (finansskatt) [national]
rows.value: Companies liable to the financial tax on wages pay state income tax at 25% instead of 22%. Paid by companies in the financial sector. Stortingets skattevedtak for inntektsåret 2026, § 3-3.

rows.source_title: Lovdata: Lov om kringkasting og audiovisuelle bestillingstjenester mv. (kringkastingsloven), §§ 8-1 to 8-3 (as amended by lov 20 des 2019 nr. 110, in force 1 January 2020)
rows.label: Broadcasting licence fee: none since 2020 (kringkastingsavgift) [national]
rows.value: None since 1 January 2020: the broadcasting licence fee is collected only for liability that arose before that date. Paid by no one. Kringkastingsloven §§ 8-1 to 8-3, as amended by lov 20 des 2019 nr. 110.
